description: At the company chosen from find_companies (pass its `company`). For a job that needs a quote, not a fixed price: sends the company the client's description of the job (what, where, how big, how urgent), their contact and address, and links to photos if the client gave any. The company writes the quote itself and sends it to the client (WhatsApp, or e-mail when given) — say so. Use a service whose booking is «quote request» from list_services (required when it lists more than one). A company without one books an on-site estimate instead (book_appointment with a service whose booking is «an assessment visit»). Only after the client confirmed the description and their contact.

address.description: Where the work is: street, building, apartment, city.

answers.description: Answers to the service's questions: { question_id: option_id | [option_ids] | number | text }. Use the ids from list_services.

client_email.description: Optional: the quote goes to this e-mail instead of WhatsApp.

company.description: The company: the `company` of a find_companies result.

description.description: The job in the client's words, 10–2000 characters.

lang.description: Language for names and labels: ru, es, en, ar, pt, fr, de, it, tr, id, vi, th. Default en.

photo_urls.description: Optional: up to 5 https links to photos the client shared.

service.description: A quote-request service key from list_services; may be left out when there is only one.

name: request_quote
title: Ask the company for a quote
